title: Antlers & Sunset
blurb: Evening settles over a half-sun of slatted lumber pillars, patterned with antlers, in the meadow facing Mt. Hood.

title: Forest Baskets
blurb: Fallen branches woven into an enchanted bower, with baskets for small gatherings and tunnels through the undergrowth.

title: Never Just One Thing
blurb: About 80 lumber gates wind around the stage, the tallest 27 feet, with lights sparkling in the arches after dark.

title: The Shroud
blurb: Walk past the Galaxy Barn and a shroud shows you back to yourself, altered, beside a wall of light.

title: Passage & Pause
blurb: A circular timber frame drawn from the farm's pastures, stables and forest paths. Pass through, or stop in the middle.

title: The Spirits of the Grove
blurb: Giant painted flowers, a frog, a king of the grove and bigfoot hands. After dark, their eyes light up.

title: Forms of Wind
blurb: Booths clad in exploded windmill blades, hand-built windchimes, and night fabrics that wave like the northern lights.

title: Architecture of the Air
blurb: Colorful fabric canopies float overhead and guide you along the path toward the Paddock.

title: 1,000 Cranes
blurb: Under a thousand paper cranes for peace, prosperity and hope: tea ceremonies, sound baths and tarot.

title: Captain Coyote
blurb: Walk through sea-serpent gateways to shipwreck stages in the woods, where Captain Coyote is in charge.

title: Time and Transformation
blurb: A secret haven beside the stream, under a vibrant canopy of reflective installations.

title: Forest in the Forest
blurb: Twenty-six steam-bent hemlock arches, about 20 feet tall, shaped like branches, leaves and petals.

title: 1950s Desert Space Trip
blurb: Rockets, cowgirls and cacti: a nostalgic road trip through the desert and into space.

title: String Theory
blurb: The structure reads as the strings of string theory, pulling the forest's natural forces into view.

title: Cable-Reel Towers
blurb: More than 175 wooden cable reels stacked into two 21-foot towers, and a hill that comes alive at night.

title: Robots from Planet Stoke
blurb: A cosmic sanctuary of wood-carved geometry and a spaceship, with a story about robots from planet Stoke.

title: Apple-Bin Orchard
blurb: Seven towers of stacked apple bins, a tilted Queen Blossom at the center, all lit up at night.

title: Gates of Hell
blurb: The barn as the gates of hell, with a chortling demon over the stage and bars all around.
